description: Response and transport sequences, and the attempts and sleeps each must produce. See conformance/README.md.

vectors.description: 429 is always retried, after the next UTC minute plus up to 1 s of jitter.
0.5 s before the minute turns, the wait is still at least 1 s.
At 0 s into a minute the window has just started: wait 60 s plus jitter.
Three 429s with max_retries 2: the third is raised. The clock moves with each sleep.
30 s to the next minute is more than max_retry_wait 10: raise at once, without sleeping.
max_retries 0 disables every retry.
Nothing reached the server: always retried, even a send without a reference.
Pre-send failures every time: the last is raised as APIConnectionError.
The request may have been processed: a send without a reference is not retried.
With user_reference_id the server de-duplicates, so the send is retried.
The first attempt reached the server before timing out; the retry is refused as a duplicate. attempts is 2, which tells the caller the first attempt probably succeeded.
Connection reset after sending: not retried without a reference.
email.send is never retry-safe: its reference check has no unique index, so even with user_reference_id a failure after sending is not retried.
A timeout after sending is not retried on email, reference or not: the first attempt may still be running.
A 5xx on email is not retried, reference or not.
A 429 never reached processing, so email is retried after it like any call.
Nothing was sent, so email is retried after a refused connection like any call.
A 5xx on a send without a reference is raised at once.
A 5xx on a send with a reference is retried.
Read operations are always retried on 5xx.
Full-jitter backoff: random(0, min(8, 0.5 * 2^n)) after failed attempt n.
With max_retries 5 the backoff cap grows to 8 s and stays there.

vectors.description: health is a read operation.
SEND_FAILED is retried only when the send is de-duplicated.
SEND_FAILED with a reference is retried.
A template send is retry-safe only when every recipient has a user_reference_id.
5xx on a fully referenced template send is retried.
One recipient without a reference makes the whole send unsafe to retry.
Pre-send failures are retried whatever the references.
400 is never retried.
401 is never retried, even on a read operation.
Other 4xx are never retried.
A success:false other than SEND_FAILED is final, reference or not.
status:false on a balance endpoint is final.
Each attempt is judged on its own: the 429 is retried, the 500 that follows is not.
Mixed causes share one retry budget.
A 2xx without a JSON object is not retried.
